messages:
elliot: quick ping — ops flagged tenants with mixed v1/v2 routing, looks like pin eviction + header variance.
mei: can you paste sample header?
elliot: x-redwood-client: {"ver":"v1","env":"mobile"} then later {"ver":"v1","env":"mobile-red"} -> treated different.
chris: we're using full header blob for pin hash. brittle.
mei: proposal: canonicalize pin key to just version + session_id when present. variant put in telemetry only.
elliot: run canonicalization in observe mode 48h on 3% of traffic, record `pin_canon_diff`.
chris: add circuit: if `pin_canon_diff` > 0.5% AND errors up -> auto-disable for tenant.
ux-bot: UX: add tenant toggle "Pin normalization" and show "preview remap" list.
deploy-bot: queued: feature/pin-canon -> staging (canary 3%).
mei: telemetry labels: declared_ver, effective_pin, canon_applied:true/false. do not log raw header.
elliot: SDK note: we'll notify partners, provide code snippet to emit normalized header.
chris: I'll implement shadow and CRC32 hash salted by tenant.
mei: thanks. reconvene after 48h of shadows.
deploy-bot: canary started: /deploys/1787654322/pin-canon
elliot: closing thread, follow-ups in PRs.
